description: This Scala source file defines the SparkConnectResultSet class, which implements the JDBC ResultSet interface for handling query results in Spark Connect. It manages iteration over Spark query results, data retrieval, and metadata access.

classes.name: SparkConnectResultSet
classes.description: A JDBC ResultSet implementation for Spark Connect, providing data access and iteration over Spark query results.

methods.name: wasNull
methods.description: Indicates if the last column read was SQL NULL.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves the cursor to the next row of the result set.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the result set and releases resources.

methods.name: checkOpen
methods.description: Checks if the result set is open; throws SQLException if closed.

methods.name: findColumn
methods.description: Finds the index of a column given its label.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as a String.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as a Boolean.

methods.name: getByte
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as a Byte.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as a Short.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as an Integer.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as a Long.

methods.name: getFloat
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as a Float.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as a Double.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as a byte array.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as a Date.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as a Time, converting LocalTime to milliseconds.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as a Timestamp, handling different timestamp types.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a column as an Object.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Returns metadata about the result set.

methods.name: getRow
methods.description: Returns the current row number.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the result set type (forward-only).

methods.name: getConcurrency
methods.description: Returns the concurrency mode (read-only).
